description: A company's logo as a directly embeddable image URL, chosen for the background you name. Use this rather than brand when the mark is all you need — it costs a fifth as much and returns one asset instead of the whole record.

domain.description: The company domain, e.g. stripe.com. A full URL works too.

theme.description: The background the logo will sit on. Defaults to light.

type.description: The square mark, or the full logotype. Defaults to icon.

name: logo
title: Logo
